description: This file defines data structures and a class for managing watch notifications inbox state on an Apple Watch app. It includes mechanisms for persisting state, consuming messages, and posting local notifications.

classes.name: WatchInboxStore
classes.description: An observable class that manages the inbox state for watch notifications, including persistence, message consumption, and local notification posting.

classes.name: PersistedState
classes.description: A private struct used for persisting the state of WatchInboxStore.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Processes an incoming notification message, updates state, and triggers a local notification.

methods.name: restorePersistedState
methods.description: Restores the store's state from UserDefaults.

methods.name: persistState
methods.description: Saves the current state into UserDefaults.

methods.name: deliveryKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for each message based on its ID or content.

methods.name: ensureNotificationAuthorization
methods.description: Requests notification permissions if not already granted.

methods.name: mapHapticRisk
methods.description: Maps a risk level string to a corresponding haptic type.

methods.name: makeReplyDraft
methods.description: Creates a reply draft for a user prompt action.

methods.name: markReplySending
methods.description: Marks the reply as being sent and updates the state.

methods.name: markReplyResult
methods.description: Updates the reply status based on the result of a send attempt.

methods.name: postLocalNotification
methods.description: Posts a local notification to the watch and plays haptic feedback.
